script_text: Taurus, this week the cosmos is asking you to dig deep and stand firm in your earthy power. Early on, Mars in Leo trines your 1st House, injecting energy, but Mercury in Scorpio squares Venus, creating communication friction in your 7th House of partnerships by Wednesday. Mid-week, a supportive trine from Venus to Jupiter in your 3rd House of communication acts as a major turning point, boosting your financial negotiations. As the weekend approaches, the Sun in Scorpio intensifies your 7th House of relationships, demanding honesty, while Saturn in Capricorn trines your 2nd House, securing your financial stability. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines Jupiter in your 3rd House, making it ideal for love and contracts. Friday is your worst day as Mars opposes your 7th House of partnerships, bringing tension. Ground your practical nature and speak your truth. Follow for daily updates.
